frames.gloss: 如此……以至于（引出结果从句）
frames.pattern_notes: 固定关联结构 so + 形容词/副词 + that 完整从句，that 常被误读为指示代词或关系代词。变体：so + 同一形容词重复（a broad discipline — so broad that...）。与清单中 enough to / so as to 同族但引出的是完整从句，是它们的从句级对应式。

examples.s: The eruption was so fierce that dust thrown into the stratosphere darkened the skies, cancelling the following summer in Europe and North America.
Anthropology is thus a broad discipline — so broad that it is generally broken down into three smaller disciplines: physical anthropology, cultural anthropology and archaeology.
Indeed, the purple colour extracted from a snail was once so costly that in society at the time only the rich could afford it.

frames.gloss: 在最广义/较窄/狭义的意义上（限定概念的使用范围）
frames.pattern_notes: 学术语篇高频的元语言框架：介词 in/at + 限定词 + 范围形容词 + sense（或省略 sense 直接用 at its 最高级）。sense 在此义为'意义'而非'感觉'，学习者常读错；用于宣告术语的宽窄用法。

examples.s: Anthropology, at its broadest, is the study of humanity — our physical characteristic as animals and our unique non-biological characteristics that we call culture.

Anthropologists also use the term ‘culture’ in a more re- stricted sense when they refer to the ‘culture’ of a particular society, meaning the non- biological characteristics unique to that society, which distinguish it from other societies.

In the broadest sense, just as archaeology is an aspect of anthropology, so too is it a part of history — where we mean the whole history of humankind from its beginnings over three million years ago.
commonly drawn distinction is between pre-history, i.e. the period before written records — and history in the narrow sense, meaning the study of the past using written evidence.

frames.gloss: whereas A，而 B 则……（前置对比）
frames.pattern_notes: 书内已有 While 让步主句、句尾对比 while；此为同族新变体：whereas 从句整体前置、纯粹对比（非让步），主句为对比焦点。whereas 对学习者是低频词，常读慢或与 where/while 混淆。

examples.s: Whereas most exercises are designed to build up strength or endurance, plyometrics focuses on increasing power — the rate at which an athlete can expend energy.

Whereas cultural anthropolo- gists will often base their conclusions on the experience of living within contemporary communities, archaeologists study past societies primarily through their material remains — the buildings, tools and other artefacts that constitutes what is known as the material culture left over from former societies.

frames.frame: In the case of [NP] / In [N's] case, [主句]
frames.pattern_notes: 半固定介词框架 In the case of + 专名（变体 In 某人's case），后接回指性主句（常用 this/it）。易与 in case of（万一）混淆，是典型读慢点。

examples.s: In the case of Mount Pinatubo, this took 600 years.
In Fosbury’s case, it was the cushions that jumpers land on.

frames.gloss: X 逐渐被视为 Y（历时演变）
frames.pattern_notes: be known/regarded as 清单框架的新变体：加 come to 表'逐渐进入某状态'，come to + be + V-ed + as 串联被动与渐变，come 的过去式易被误读为实义动词'来'。

examples.s: Like education, political and legal processes and institutions, public order, communication, transport and money supply, health-care came to be seen as one of the fundamental social facilities necessary for people to exercise their other rights as autonomous human beings.
Health-care came to be seen as a right at about the same time that the limits of health-care resources became evident.

frames.gloss: （由于/在……之后）做了某事，主句（句首无连词分词）
frames.pattern_notes: 清单已有'主句, V-ing'（后置）与'when/while V-ing'（带连词），此为前置新变体：句首裸分词短语表原因/伴随/评注（Realising X / Utilising X / Looking back），分词的逻辑主语须后指主句主语，学习者常把分词误当主句谓语。

examples.s: Looking back, it now seems quite incredible that in the national health systems that emerged in many counties in the years immediately after the 1939—45 World War, it was assumed without question that all the basic health needs of any community could be satisfied, at least in principle; the ‘invisible hand’ of economic progress would provide.
Incorporating potassium dichromate and alcohol into the aniline at various stages of the experimental process, he finally produced a deep purple solution.
Realising the importance of this breakthrough, he lost no time in patenting it.
Utilising the cheap and plentiful coal tar that was an almost unlimited byproduct of London’s gas street lighting, the dye works began producing the world’s first synthetically dyed material in 1857.

frames.pattern_notes: '主句, V-ing'清单框架的新变体：后置分词前加 thus 明示结果衔接，thus + V-ing + 宾语整存整取，学习者常在 thus 处断句或误读为 thus that。

examples.s: Perkin quickly grasped that his purple solution could be used to colour fabric, thus making it the world’s first synthetic dye.
Not to be outdone, England’s Queen Victoria also appeared in public wearing a mauve gown, thus making it all the rate in England as well.

frames.gloss: 诸如……之类的 N（后接列举）
frames.pattern_notes: such + 名词 + as + 并列项，不同于普通 such as 列举（such as 前无名词紧贴）。such 在此被误读为强调词'如此'导致读错重心；as 引出的是 N 的成员清单。

examples.s: Historically, textile dyes were made from such natural sources as plants and animal excretions.
For instance, they were used to stain previously invisible microbes and bacteria, allowing researchers to identify such bacilli as tuberculosis, cholera, and anthrax.

frames.gloss: 在……如何/是什么的方面（介词后接 wh-从句）
frames.pattern_notes: 介词（in/about 等）直接带缩略疑问从句作补语：improvement in how fast athletes run / in what would have been particularly pleasing to Perkin。学习者不习惯介词后跟完整 wh-从句，是最典型的读慢点；what 从句内还含虚拟完成体。

examples.s: — Limits to human sporting performance are not yet in sight — Since the early years of the twentieth century, when the International Athletic Federa- tion began keeping records, there has been a steady improvement in how fast athletes run, how high they jump and how far they are able to hurl massive objects, themselves included, through space.
And, in what would have been particularly pleasing to Perkin, their current use is in the search for a vaccine against malaria.

frames.frame: at (about/exactly) the same time that/as [S V], [主句]
frames.gloss: 就在……的同时（same...that/as 关联结构）
frames.pattern_notes: the same + time + that/as + 完整从句：that 在此非关系代词也非指示词，而是 same 的固定搭配连词，学习者普遍读错；time 前可插 about/exactly/just 等修饰。

examples.s: However, at exactly the same time as this new realization of the finite character of health-care resources was sinking in, an awareness of a contrary kind was developing in Western societies: that people have a basic right to health-care as a necessary condition of a proper human life.
Health-care came to be seen as a right at about the same time that the limits of health-care resources became evident.

frames.gloss: 正如 A 一样，B 也……（so too 倒装回指）
frames.pattern_notes: just as + 从句前置（或后置依附主句），配 so too is/does + 主语的倒装回指；so too 倒装是高难读点。两种位置变体：Just as A, so too is B；主句, just as B（无 so too）。

examples.s: In the broadest sense, just as archaeology is an aspect of anthropology, so too is it a part of history — where we mean the whole history of humankind from its beginnings over three million years ago.
The archaeologist has to develop a picture of the past, just as the scientist has to develop a coherent view of the natural world.

candidates.s: But a linguist’s personal judgments are often uncertain, or disagree with the judgments of other linguists, at which point recourse is needed to more objective methods of enquiry, using non-linguists as informants.
candidates.note: at which point recourse is needed...：介词+which 前置关系从句（清单已含 for/during+which），'at which point' 是更高频整存整取词组，但本批仅此 1 句，重复数不足。

candidates.s: Often, the re- searcher wishes to obtain information about just a single variable, in which case a re- stricted set of questions may be used: a particular feature of pronunciation, for example, can be elicited by asking the informant to say a restricted set of words.
candidates.note: in which case a restricted set of questions may be used：句际衔接 in which case S V，高价值词组，仅 1 句。

candidates.s: The size of the corpus depends on practical factors, such as the time available to collect, process and store the data: it can take up to several hours to provide an accurate transcription of a few minutes of speech.
candidates.note: it can take up to several hours to provide...：形式主语 it + take + 时间 + to V，仅 1 句（另一处 I00790 为听力选项，不计）。

candidates.s: An important principle is that all corpora, whatever their size, are inevitably limited in their coverage, and always need to be supplemented by data derived from the intuitions of native speakers of the language, through either introspection or experimentation.
candidates.note: all corpora, whatever their size, are inevitably limited：whatever+N 省略型让步（无主谓），仅 1 句。

candidates.s: Where possible, therefore, the recording has to be supplemented by the observer’s written comments on the non-verbal behavior of the participants, and about the context in general.
candidates.note: Where possible, therefore, the recording has to be supplemented：where+possible 省略型 where 从句，仅 1 句。

candidates.s: However far from reality such portrayals are, they capture the essential truth that archaeology is an exciting quest — the quest for knowledge about ourselves and our past.
candidates.note: However far from reality such portrayals are, they capture...：让步倒装（However+表语+主谓），误读判据极强，但本批仅 1 句。

candidates.s: The Nature and Aims of Archaeology Archaeology is partly the discovery of the treasures of the past, partly the careful work of the scientific analyst, partly the exercise of the creative imagination.
candidates.note: Archaeology is partly A, partly B, partly C：partly 排比框架，修辞价值高，仅 1 句。

candidates.s: Thus, in the 1950s and 1960s, there emerged an awareness in Western societies that resources for the provision of fossil fuel energy were finite and exhaustible and that the capacity of nature or the environment to sustain economic development and population was also finite.
candidates.note: there emerged an awareness in Western societies that...：there+实义动词 emerge 的存现句（非 there be），仅 1 句。

candidates.s: Physical anthropology, or biological anthropology as it is also called, concerns the study of human biological or physical characteristics and how they evolved.
candidates.note: Physical anthropology, or biological anthropology as it is also called：'X, or Y as it is also called,' 别名同位框架，仅 1 句。

candidates.s: As the 1976 declaration of the World Health Organization put it: ‘The enjoyment of the highest attainable standard of health is one of the fundamental rights of every human being without distinction of race, religion, political belief, economic or social condition.’ As has just been remarked, in a liberal society basic health is seen as one of the indispensable conditions for the exercise of personal autonomy.
candidates.note: As the 1976 declaration of the WHO put it: ... / As has just been remarked,...：as 句级回指两种形态，但同在 1 条内，重复数不足。

candidates.s: It was against this backdrop that Perkin’s discovery was made.
candidates.note: It was against this backdrop that Perkin's discovery was made.：分裂句新变体（against this backdrop 作焦点），仅 1 句。

candidates.s: Not to be outdone, England’s Queen Victoria also appeared in public wearing a mauve gown, thus making it all the rate in England as well.
candidates.note: Not to be outdone, England's Queen Victoria also appeared in public...：'Not to be outdone' 不甘示弱插入语，仅 1 句。

candidates.s: Of a town of 28,000, only two people survived.
candidates.note: Of a town of 28,000, only two people survived.：Of 整体前置 + only 部分聚焦，仅 1 句。

candidates.s: People are not in a position to exercise personal liberty and to be self-determining if they are poverty-stricken, or deprived of basic education, or do not live within a context of law and order.
candidates.note: People are not in a position to exercise personal liberty：be not in a position to V（无法/没资格），高价值词块，仅 1 句。

candidates.s: Some recordings are made without the speakers being aware of the fact — a procedure that obtains very natural data, though ethical objections must be anticipated.
candidates.note: though ethical objections must be anticipated（句尾/括号内 though 让步，与 I00730 同族共 2 句，但 though=although 属基础语法，误读判据拿不准）。

candidates.s: When a sprinter runs, Yessis explains, her foot stays in contact with the ground for just under a tenth of a second, half of which is devoted to landing and the other half to pushing off.
candidates.note: half of which is devoted to landing and the other half to pushing off：数字+of which 关系从句 + the other half 承前省略，仅 1 句。

candidates.s: Archaeologists in recent decades have developed ‘ethnography’, where, like ethnographers, they live among contemporary communities, but with the specific purpose of learning how such societies use material culture — how they make their tools and weapons, why they build their settlements where they do, and so on.
candidates.note: but with the specific purpose of learning how...：with the [specific] purpose of V-ing 目的框架，仅 1 句。

candidates.s: Focused training will also play a role in enabling records to be broken. ‘If we applied the Russian training model to some of the outstanding runners we have in this country,’ Yessis asserts, ‘they would be breaking records left and right.’ He will not predict by how much, however: ‘Exactly what the limits are it’s hard to say, but there will be increase even if only by hundredths of a second, as long as our training continues to improve.’ One of the most important new methodologies is biomechanics, the study of the body in motion.
candidates.note: For the foreseeable future, records will be made to be broken.：修辞双关（be made to be broken），趣味句，仅 1 句。
